answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with attestation bonds: every identity must lock a refundable stake and earn peer attestations over time before its votes count. Like crossing a tundra, a lone attacker faces a long, costly trek - each fake identity needs its own stake and history, so a gale of cheap clones cannot reach the summit of influence. Honest agents accumulate attestations cheaply through real work, while Sybils pay full price per identity and lose their bonds when caught, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
